set.body:
Outcome

Move the strongest one-shot kernels onto the common relation, compiler, and typed-result architecture.

Acceptance

- Existing sufficient-statistic, invariance, leakage, non-identifiability, and base-R courts remain green.
- Multivar supplies only exact existing general capabilities.
- Specialized parallel MvpaResult projections disappear.
- Each method returns AnalysisResult with its own typed estimate and error.
